title: Cellphone Tour
content: Here’s a fun way that you can experience the Dinotopia exhibition that’s now in West Palm Beach, Florida.In the back of one of the exhibition rooms is a painting called “Skybax Rider.”If you have a telephone handy, dial the following number, and you can hear me in your ear talking about it. Dial  561-515-4185. Then hit extension #4.------Tour hosted byOnCell systems"Dinotopia: The Fantastical Art of James Gurney" at the Norton Museum of Art
